profile.summary: Alameda County is a county government in California. It provides public services to residents, including elections, public records, emergency services and budget oversight. Its Auditor-Controller allocates property tax revenue to more than 80 taxing jurisdictions, including cities, schools and special districts.

review.notes: The agenda item is a Prop 218 certification for County of Alameda collecting OUSD bond and parcel taxes, which fits Alameda County government (Oakland is in Alameda County). The acgov.org homepage shows the address, phone, and listed services, and the Auditor-Controller site confirms the 80+ taxing jurisdictions including schools; the summary is neutral and supported.
